verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo documents a catalog of 600+ connectors spanning APIs, databases, data warehouses and data lakes, and the docs and site claim hundreds of sources and 700+ systems. Community users describe pulling data from many unusual places and say it works well for most use cases. The Connector Builder covers gaps in the catalog. missing for 10: evidence on how connectors are maintained (support/certification tiers), explicit coverage of file-based sources, independent corroboration of catalog breadth and quality.
